raw_segments.text: Meanwhile, Neptune had kept no blind lookout, and came up to them in the semblance of an
He took Agamemnon's right hand in his own and said,
Son of Atreus, I take it Achilles is glad now that he sees the Achaeans rooted and slain,
for he is utterly without remorse.
May he come to a bad end, and heaven confound him.
As for yourself, the blessed gods are not yet so bitterly angry with you, but that the
princes and counselors of the Trojans shall again raise the dust upon the plain, and you
shall see them flying from the ship's intents towards their city.
